plugins.name: viralhunt
plugins.description: Discover trending/viral content across TikTok, Instagram, X, Facebook, Pinterest, Bluesky, Douyin, Reddit, Mastodon, Tumblr, Hacker News and news RSS; learn the best time to post, top hashtags, trending sounds and the best communities for a topic; make on-brand images from the organization's templates; leave complete posts as drafts for review or review them; translate a post into a linked project's language; and schedule or publish posts to your connected social accounts via the ViralHunt.io API.

skills.name: viralhunt
skills.description: Discover what's trending/going viral across TikTok, Instagram, X, Facebook, Pinterest, Bluesky, Douyin, Reddit, Mastodon, Tumblr, Hacker News and news RSS, learn the best time to post on each network from measured viral posts, find the top hashtags, trending sounds and best communities, make on-brand images from the organization's templates, leave complete posts as drafts for a person to review (or review them yourself), translate a post into a linked project's language, and schedule or publish posts to the user's own connected social accounts — powered by the ViralHunt.io API. Use this when the user has a ViralHunt account or token (or wants one) and asks to find viral or trending content in a niche through ViralHunt, to research what is performing on social right now, to know when or where to post, to run a standing content job for a brand, to check or review ViralHunt drafts, or to draft, schedule or publish social posts through their ViralHunt-connected accounts. Do not use it for social media advice that needs no data, for operating a social network's own app or API directly, or for other scheduling tools.
headings: 0. First call: who is this key
3. When and where to post (best time, hashtags, sounds, communities)
5b. Drafts and review (the limbo before sending)
7. Edit or cancel a scheduled post
8b. Quotes (a daily quote, picked by popularity and category)
9. Content templates (make the image, don't just write the caption)
10. Studio: recipes, the quote templates and author portraits
skills.description_zh: 通过ViralHunt API研究多社交平台及RSS趋势、发布时机、标签声音社区，按品牌模板制作图片，起草审阅翻译并安排或发布到已连接自有账户；适用于有账户或令牌的ViralHunt数据工作，不直接操作平台原生API或其他调度工具。

commands.name: job
commands.description: The standing job on one page or account: take its most viral posts, verify each, rewrite for the brand, make the image on a template, leave drafts a few a day

commands.name: publish
commands.description: Publish now or schedule a post on the user's connected accounts (or leave it as a draft), with per-network copy and the media checked against each network's ceilings

commands.name: review
commands.description: Review the drafts waiting in ViralHunt as the team's checker: terms of each network, unverified claims, sensationalism, grammar; one review per draft, never an approval

commands.name: start
commands.description: Introduce ViralHunt in three lines, check where the user is (token, plan, connected accounts, templates, drafts) and propose the one next step

commands.name: stats
commands.description: What performed: the networks' own engagement of the posts published through ViralHunt, by network and by brand, and more content like the winners

commands.name: trending
commands.description: What is viral right now on one network or all of them, for a niche, a keyword or one page; with measured growth and the sample behind it
